zoe-finops: Team, nightly allocation flagged $4,600 GPU on project redwood-dedicated as `misc_customer`. This is large enough to affect customer invoices. Anyone know which dedicated customer owns it?
max-infra: hmm that project hosts multiple dedicated customer pools. likely the kube-tenant label didn't propagate for a short window during the maintenance window.
harper-sales: could be the new partner rollout (NovaAI) — AM reported unusual usage last night.
zoe-finops: snippet from export:
```
invoice_id,resource,region,amount,customer_label
inv-2026-04-01,gpu-ded-004,us-central1,4600.00,misc_customer
inv-2026-04-01,gpu-ded-005,us-central1,300.00,NovaAI
```
max-infra: I'll run a targeted backfill against tenancy logs for the 6-hour window. If we can attribute to NovaAI, we should reissue corrected invoice.
billing-bot: Ticket FIN-845 created for unallocated dedicated GPU spend. https://billing.internal/tickets/FIN-845
zoe-finops: timeline: need either corrected invoice or provisional credit within 3 business days. Sara, want to approve provisional credit policy?
sara-cfo: provisional policy stands: if >80% attributable by backfill -> correct invoice; if 50-80% -> provisional credit for the ambiguous portion; if <50% -> absorb to dedicated contingency and investigate.
harper-sales: AM says NovaAI likely 100% for that window but wants confirmation before we re-bill.
max-infra: backfill job bg-ded-backfill-1785 started. linking tenancy map to resource tags.
billing-bot: Backfill job bg-ded-backfill-1785 completed. Matched 92% of the $4,600 to NovaAI (remainder $368 ambiguous).
zoe-finops: great. per policy, reissue corrected invoice and apply provisional credit $368. I'll prepare the invoice note and ledger entry.
sara-cfo: approve. please add a short customer note: "We corrected an allocation that temporarily misattributed GPU usage; provisional credit applied for the ambiguous portion. See FIN-845 for details." Legal to review customer wording.
harper-sales: AM will get the corrected invoice and call scheduled.
max-infra: follow-up: deploying fix to tag propagation (retry on label write + clearer tenant propagation logs). PR#4890.
zoe-finops: thanks. I'll update FIN-845 and close once invoice confirmed sent. :white_check_mark:
